question.text: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

exchange.sent: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
Vector Network Analyzer fits in the **high-speed digital / signal-integrity test workflow** for AI data center hardware, especially around **PCB/PCBA high-speed traces, server PCBs, GPU/CPU-related interconnects, connectors/cables, sockets, and transmission-line validation**; the supported measurement items include **IL, TDR, impedance, insertion loss, return loss, high-speed trace test, and high-speed cable test** [9][30][43].
### Workflow placement
| Test workflow point | Where VNA fits | Supported measurement / DUT context |
|---|---|---|
| Electrical interface / transmission-channel validation | Network analyzers are listed among instruments for transmission-channel and electrical-interface validation challenges [18]. | Transmission channel, measurement path to DUT / test board development, PDN, RefClk / PLL jitter, interface test context [18]. |
| PCB fabricator / system-house PCB test flow | The PCB workflow includes material measurement, material/stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring [3][34]. | Items in that workflow include impedance/TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, and cable / connector testing [34][57]. |
| AI server PCB / server board SI test | R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB are mapped to server PCB IL and TDR, and R&S ZNA is mapped to server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace test [9][43]. | Server PCB: IL, TDR; server motherboard / PCBA: high-speed trace test [9][43]. |
| GPU / CPU high-speed interconnect context | R&S ZNA is mapped to GPU TDR and appears in the CPU row of the AI server ecosystem mapping [9][43]. | GPU: TDR; CPU: R&S ZNA listed, but the specific CPU test item is not explained [43]. |
| Connector / cable validation | R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB plus OSP are mapped to connector / cable high-speed cable testing [43]. | Connector / cable: high-speed cable test [43]. |
| Probing and de-embedding validation | VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner are described as a total solution for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation measurement problems [39]. | Bare Board for SoCs PCB test with probing includes impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, with offered solution ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool [30]. |
| Sampling / process-monitoring side of PCB workflow | The PCB test flow includes sampling testing for IL, DK/DF, and impedance, plus PL / process monitoring, but the source does not provide the VNA model or formal setup for those stages [34][37]. | Sampling testing: IL, DK/DF, impedance; process monitoring is listed but PL is not expanded [34][37]. |
### Product linkage supported by the passages
R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series covering 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz models in the cited specification context [72][82].  
R&S ZNB3044 is a Vector Network Analyzer model with a base frequency range of 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz, and with a frequency upgrade option it can reach 54.0 GHz [81].  
The AI server mapping links R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB to server PCB IL/TDR, connector/cable high-speed cable testing, network switch VNA usage, and optical VNA contexts, but it is only a sales / test-solution mapping and not a formal configuration guide [43][45][46].  
### Limitation
The passages do not provide a formal AI data center VNA test setup, option code, fixture, calibration method, frequency plan, pass/fail limit, or ordering configuration for this workflow [37][43][46].

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。

- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。

- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

Release 18 CSI enhancements for high-speed scenario › Release 18 主要 enhancement
來源 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]] 列出三個主要 CSI enhancements：

1. [[Cooperative Coherent Joint Transmission]]（CJT）。
2. [[CSI prediction]]。
3. [[Time Domain Channel Properties]]（TDCP）：新的 CSI quantity，可提供 time-domain channel variability 與 [[UE]] motion relative to the [[gNB]] 的 additional information。

來源另提到 Type II PMI at higher speeds 搭配 Doppler / time-domain compression，並提到 `typeII-Doppler-r18` report / codebook type。[[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]]

[[Type II CSI enhancements for high-speed Ues]] 進一步補充 Type II CSI high-speed UE 的機制：

- UE 使用 previous [[CSI-RS]] information，利用 time correlation / Doppler 進行 prediction。
- 採用 UE prediction 而非 gNB prediction，來源理由是 UE has full channel information in real time，而 gNB only has quantized information。
- Prediction models classically use [[Wiener filter]] or [[Kalman filter]] 這類 filters。
- 對 future predicted time points，可取得 corresponding precoding matrices；several Eigenvector-based precoding matrix sets 由 channel prediction 得到，並透過 [[beam-delay representation]] 做 space and frequency compression。
- RAN1 simulations 多數針對 30 km/h 與 60 km/h speeds。

### Short answer
Vector Network Analyzer fits in the **high-speed digital / signal-integrity test workflow** for AI data center hardware, especially around **PCB/PCBA high-speed traces, server PCBs, GPU/CPU-related interconnects, connectors/cables, sockets, and transmission-line validation**; the supported measurement items include **IL, TDR, impedance, insertion loss, return loss, high-speed trace test, and high-speed cable test** [9][30][43].
### Workflow placement
| Test workflow point | Where VNA fits | Supported measurement / DUT context |
|---|---|---|
| Electrical interface / transmission-channel validation | Network analyzers are listed among instruments for transmission-channel and electrical-interface validation challenges [18]. | Transmission channel, measurement path to DUT / test board development, PDN, RefClk / PLL jitter, interface test context [18]. |
| PCB fabricator / system-house PCB test flow | The PCB workflow includes material measurement, material/stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring [3][34]. | Items in that workflow include impedance/TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, and cable / connector testing [34][57]. |
| AI server PCB / server board SI test | R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB are mapped to server PCB IL and TDR, and R&S ZNA is mapped to server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace test [9][43]. | Server PCB: IL, TDR; server motherboard / PCBA: high-speed trace test [9][43]. |
| GPU / CPU high-speed interconnect context | R&S ZNA is mapped to GPU TDR and appears in the CPU row of the AI server ecosystem mapping [9][43]. | GPU: TDR; CPU: R&S ZNA listed, but the specific CPU test item is not explained [43]. |
| Connector / cable validation | R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB plus OSP are mapped to connector / cable high-speed cable testing [43]. | Connector / cable: high-speed cable test [43]. |
| Probing and de-embedding validation | VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner are described as a total solution for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation measurement problems [39]. | Bare Board for SoCs PCB test with probing includes impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, with offered solution ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool [30]. |
| Sampling / process-monitoring side of PCB workflow | The PCB test flow includes sampling testing for IL, DK/DF, and impedance, plus PL / process monitoring, but the source does not provide the VNA model or formal setup for those stages [34][37]. | Sampling testing: IL, DK/DF, impedance; process monitoring is listed but PL is not expanded [34][37]. |
### Product linkage supported by the passages
R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series covering 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz models in the cited specification context [72][82].  
R&S ZNB3044 is a Vector Network Analyzer model with a base frequency range of 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz, and with a frequency upgrade option it can reach 54.0 GHz [81].  
The AI server mapping links R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB to server PCB IL/TDR, connector/cable high-speed cable testing, network switch VNA usage, and optical VNA contexts, but it is only a sales / test-solution mapping and not a formal configuration guide [43][45][46].  
### Limitation
The passages do not provide a formal AI data center VNA test setup, option code, fixture, calibration method, frequency plan, pass/fail limit, or ordering configuration for this workflow [37][43][46].

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

Release 18 CSI enhancements for high-speed scenario › Release 18 主要 enhancement
來源 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]] 列出三個主要 CSI enhancements：

1. [[Cooperative Coherent Joint Transmission]]（CJT）。
2. [[CSI prediction]]。
3. [[Time Domain Channel Properties]]（TDCP）：新的 CSI quantity，可提供 time-domain channel variability 與 [[UE]] motion relative to the [[gNB]] 的 additional information。

來源另提到 Type II PMI at higher speeds 搭配 Doppler / time-domain compression，並提到 `typeII-Doppler-r18` report / codebook type。[[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]]

[[Type II CSI enhancements for high-speed Ues]] 進一步補充 Type II CSI high-speed UE 的機制：

- UE 使用 previous [[CSI-RS]] information，利用 time correlation / Doppler 進行 prediction。
- 採用 UE prediction 而非 gNB prediction，來源理由是 UE has full channel information in real time，而 gNB only has quantized information。
- Prediction models classically use [[Wiener filter]] or [[Kalman filter]] 這類 filters。
- 對 future predicted time points，可取得 corresponding precoding matrices；several Eigenvector-based precoding matrix sets 由 channel prediction 得到，並透過 [[beam-delay representation]] 做 space and frequency compression。
- RAN1 simulations 多數針對 30 km/h 與 60 km/h speeds。

### Short answer
Vector Network Analyzer fits in the **high-speed digital / signal-integrity test workflow** for AI data center hardware, especially around **PCB/PCBA high-speed traces, server PCBs, GPU/CPU-related interconnects, connectors/cables, sockets, and transmission-line validation**; the supported measurement items include **IL, TDR, impedance, insertion loss, return loss, high-speed trace test, and high-speed cable test** [9][30][43].
### Workflow placement
| Test workflow point | Where VNA fits | Supported measurement / DUT context |
|---|---|---|
| Electrical interface / transmission-channel validation | Network analyzers are listed among instruments for transmission-channel and electrical-interface validation challenges [18]. | Transmission channel, measurement path to DUT / test board development, PDN, RefClk / PLL jitter, interface test context [18]. |
| PCB fabricator / system-house PCB test flow | The PCB workflow includes material measurement, material/stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring [3][34]. | Items in that workflow include impedance/TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, Delta-L, ISD/ADK, and cable / connector testing [34][57]. |
| AI server PCB / server board SI test | R&S ZNA and R&S ZNB are mapped to server PCB IL and TDR, and R&S ZNA is mapped to server motherboard / PCBA high-speed trace test [9][43]. | Server PCB: IL, TDR; server motherboard / PCBA: high-speed trace test [9][43]. |
| GPU / CPU high-speed interconnect context | R&S ZNA is mapped to GPU TDR and appears in the CPU row of the AI server ecosystem mapping [9][43]. | GPU: TDR; CPU: R&S ZNA listed, but the specific CPU test item is not explained [43]. |
| Connector / cable validation | R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB plus OSP are mapped to connector / cable high-speed cable testing [43]. | Connector / cable: high-speed cable test [43]. |
| Probing and de-embedding validation | VNA, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner are described as a total solution for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation measurement problems [39]. | Bare Board for SoCs PCB test with probing includes impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, with offered solution ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool [30]. |
| Sampling / process-monitoring side of PCB workflow | The PCB test flow includes sampling testing for IL, DK/DF, and impedance, plus PL / process monitoring, but the source does not provide the VNA model or formal setup for those stages [34][37]. | Sampling testing: IL, DK/DF, impedance; process monitoring is listed but PL is not expanded [34][37]. |
### Product linkage supported by the passages
R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series covering 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz models in the cited specification context [72][82].  
R&S ZNB3044 is a Vector Network Analyzer model with a base frequency range of 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz, and with a frequency upgrade option it can reach 54.0 GHz [81].  
The AI server mapping links R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB to server PCB IL/TDR, connector/cable high-speed cable testing, network switch VNA usage, and optical VNA contexts, but it is only a sales / test-solution mapping and not a formal configuration guide [43][45][46].  
### Limitation
The passages do not provide a formal AI data center VNA test setup, option code, fixture, calibration method, frequency plan, pass/fail limit, or ordering configuration for this workflow [37][43][46].

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。
